BlocK-5872 /0 12 1STReETa/k/a1/A 23mdhenue, 3 BAysze,Ny. ard ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT Bay sicde,ny AGREEMENT (this“Agreement") dated this 29th day of September,2017,between BELL APARTMENTS OWNERS CORP., a New York corporation,having an address at c/o Metro Management Inc., 42-25 21st Street, Long Island City, NY 11101 ("BELL") and CORD MEYER DEVELOPMENT LLC, a New limited liability company having an address at 111-15 Queens Boulevard, Forest Hills, NY 11375 ("Developer"). RECITALS: A. BELLis the owner of the land,buildings and improvements thereon located in the Borough and County of Queens,City and State of New York,known as Lot 2 in Block 5872 as shown on the TaxMap of the City of NewYork and more particularly described onSchedule to BELL's Property; said buildings and improvements being sometimes referred to herein, ... collectively, as“BELL's Buildings". B. Developer is the owner of certain lands adjacent to BELL's Property, known as Tax Lot 102 in Block 5872 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,County of Queens, more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, said land being herein referred to as “Developer's Land", and the owner of the Excess Development Rights appurtenant to BELL's Property and as provided herein. C. Developer may construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land, and if required, an underground parking garage (said new building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred tocollectively as“Developer'sProposed Buildings”and Developer's Land,Developer's Proposed Buildings and any and all buildings and improvements hereafter located on Developer's Land being herein referred to collectively as “Developer's Property").          s Resolution of the City of NewYork,effective December15,1961 (as amended to the date hereof and as may be further amended, the “Zoning Resolution") (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot") pursuant to Zoning Exhibit I recorded on March 10, 2017 in CRFN 2017000095535 and Zoning Exhibit III recorded on August 31,2016 in CRFN 2016000301327. E.As used herein “Floor Area Development Rights” shall mean certain rights, as determined by the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution),whereby such zoning lot may be developed by erecting thereon one or more structures with floor area determined by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) in that zoning district (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution). F. As used herein, “Retained Development Rights shall mean a portion of

the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant on the date hereof to BELL's Property equal to 491,604.4 square feet and comprising the Zoning Floor Area (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) of BELL's Buildings. G. theRetainedDevelopment Rights. H.As used herein “Up-Zoning Rights" shall mean all Floor Area Development Rights pertaining to BELL's Property or CORD MEYER's Property respectively resulting from an upward revision on or after the date hereof by New York City of the allowable floor area ratio and/or the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density or other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution that become available after the date hereof to BELL's Property or CORD MEYER's Property respectively. I. The parties agree that, on the date hereof: (i) BELL's Buildings use less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights that are permitted for development on BELL's Property pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; (i) BELL has transferred BELL's leasehold interest in the Excess Development Rights, if any, to Developer; (i) Developer has retained its residual interest in the Excess Development Rights; (iv), as a result of the foregoing, BELL's leasehold interest in the Excess Development Rights, if any, has merged with CORD MEYER's residual interest therein, with the result that Developer owns the Excess Development Rights in their entirety; (v), under procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution, the Excess Buildings with floor area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights, or any portion thereof, were not so available; and (vi), in any event, Developer shall continue to be the owner of the Excess Development Rights. J. The parties heretohave executed and delivered a certainDeclaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration"), dated the date hereof, which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the Office of the Register of Queens County, New York with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot. K.BELL's Property is contiguous with Developer's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and BELL's Property and Developer's Land are all within a single block. NOW, THEREFORE, the parties agree as follows: ARTICLEI EXCESSDEVELOPMENT RIGHTSANDEASEMENTS Section 1.1BELL hereby agrees that Developer, its successors and assigns, is the sole owner of the Excess Development Rights, and the right to use the Excess Development Rights and agrees that Developer has the sole right to utilize the Excess Development Rights in construction of Developer's Proposed Buildings, and in the event BELL has or had any right, title and interest to the Excess Development Rights, BELL has transferred and conveyed to Developer, its successors and assigns, all of BELL's right, title and interest to the Excess Development Rights
